T: Move in with Grandma. Eat like it.
D: A video game tester gets evicted and moves in with his grandma and her two housemates.
P: Serve the snacks when Alex moves in with Grandma.
S: Grandma's cheddar and chive cheese ball
Cream cheese and vintage cheddar ball with chives and Worcestershire

An old-school cheese ball of sharp cheddar, cream cheese and chives rolled in toasted pecans, served with water crackers and celery sticks. Beat 250g soft cream cheese with 150g finely grated vintage cheddar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/2 tsp garlic powder and 2 tbsp chopped chives until smooth. Shape into a ball, wrap in cling film and chill for 1 hour. Toast 80g pecans in a dry pan for 4 minutes, chop finely and mix with 2 tbsp more chives. Roll the cheese ball in the nuts until coated. Serve with 200g water crackers and 4 celery sticks cut into batons.
Rolled pizza dough with pepperoni and mozzarella, marinara to dunk

Soft pizza dough scrolls rolled with tomato sauce, pepperoni, mozzarella and oregano, baked golden and served with warm marinara for dunking. Roll 500g pizza dough on a floured bench into a 30 x 40cm rectangle. Spread with 100ml pizza sauce, then scatter with 100g sliced pepperoni, 150g grated mozzarella and 1 tsp dried oregano. Roll up tightly from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Pack into a greased 24cm tin, brush with 20g melted butter and 1 crushed garlic clove, and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden. Warm 300ml marinara sauce for dunking.
M: Glazed beef and pork meatloaf, mash on the side. Here's your din-din.

A juicy beef and pork meatloaf with a sticky brown sugar tomato glaze, served in thick slices with creamy mash and buttered peas. Soak 60g breadcrumbs in 80ml milk. Mix with 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 2 tsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp salt and pepper. Press into a lined loaf tin. Mix 100ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp cider vinegar and spread over the top. Bake at 180C for 1 hour and rest 10 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes for 20 minutes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Cook 300g peas and toss with butter.
W: Warm cinnamon butter cake and cream for the Antiques Roadshow marathon

A soft, buttery tea cake brushed with melted butter while warm and finished with a crunchy cinnamon sugar crust, served with whipped cream. Beat 100g soft butter and 150g caster sugar until pale, then beat in 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla. Fold in 200g self-raising flour alternately with 150ml milk. Spread into a lined 20cm round tin and bake at 180C for 30 to 35 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. While still hot, brush with 20g melted butter and sprinkle with 2 tbsp caster sugar mixed with 1 tsp cinnamon. Serve warm in wedges with whipped cream.
K: Sophie's tea tin peach iced tea
Plain black tea, peach and lemon over ice. Only tea in this tin.

Black tea brewed strong, chilled and shaken with peach nectar and lemon, poured over ice with fresh peach slices and mint. Steep 6 black tea bags in 1L boiling water with 3 tbsp sugar for 5 minutes. Remove the bags and cool, then chill for 1 hour. Stir in 400ml peach nectar and the juice of 1 lemon. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and a few slices of fresh peach or tinned peach. Pour over the tea and garnish each glass with a mint sprig and a lemon wheel.

dishes.n: Grandma's cheddar and chive cheese ball
dishes.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep wrapped and chilled

steps.text: Beat the cream cheese, cheddar, Worcestershire, garlic powder and most of the chives until smooth.
Shape into a ball and wrap in cling film. Chill until firm.
Toast the pecans in a dry pan, chop finely and mix with the remaining chives.
Roll the cheese ball in the nuts and serve with crackers and celery.

veg.n: Grandma's cheddar and chive cheese ball (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep wrapped and chilled

steps.text: Beat the cream cheese, cheddar, soy sauce, garlic powder and most of the chives until smooth.
Shape into a ball and wrap in cling film. Chill until firm.
Toast the pecans in a dry pan, chop finely and mix with the remaining chives.
Roll the cheese ball in the nuts and serve with the water crackers and celery.

dishes.make_ahead: Roll, cut and pack the scrolls into the tin up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; brush with butter and bake on the night

steps.text: Roll the dough on a floured bench into a large rectangle.
Spread with pizza sauce and scatter with pepperoni, mozzarella and oregano.
Roll up tightly from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Pack into a greased 24cm tin.
Brush with the melted butter and garlic, then bake at 200C until golden.
Warm the marinara and serve for dunking.

veg.n: Brainasium game tester mushroom pizza scrolls
veg.make_ahead: Roll and cut the scrolls up to 1 day ahead, covered in the tin in the fridge; brush with butter and bake on the night

steps.text: Roll the dough on a floured bench into a large rectangle.
Spread with pizza sauce and scatter with the thinly sliced mushrooms, the sliced olives, mozzarella and oregano.
Roll up tightly from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Pack into a greased 24cm tin.
Brush with the melted butter and garlic, then bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden.
Warm the marinara and serve for dunking.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the loaf and press it into the tin up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; glaze, bake and make the mash on the night

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in some of the milk, then mix with the minces, onion, egg, Worcestershire, salt and pepper.
Press into a lined loaf tin. Mix the tomato sauce, sugar and vinegar and spread over the top.
Bake at 180C, then rest.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with most of the butter and the rest of the milk.
Cook the peas and toss with the remaining butter. Slice the meatloaf and serve with mash and peas.

veg.n: Grandma's glazed lentil loaf with mash
veg.make_ahead: Make the lentil mix and press it into the tin up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; glaze, bake and make the mash on the night

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and onion in the oil until dry.
Soak the breadcrumbs in some of the milk. Mash half the lentils and mix with the rest, the mushroom mix, breadcrumbs, egg, soy sauce and salt.
Press into a lined loaf tin. Mix the tomato sauce, sugar and vinegar and spread over the top.
Bake at 180C for 45 minutes, then rest.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with most of the butter and the rest of the milk.
Cook the peas and toss with the remaining butter. Slice the loaf and serve with mash and peas.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead and wrap when cool; warm gently in the oven and whip the cream on the night

steps.text: Beat most of the butter and most of the sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Fold in the flour alternately with the milk and spread into a lined 20cm round tin.
Bake at 180C until a skewer comes out clean.
While hot, brush with the remaining melted butter and sprinkle with the remaining sugar mixed with cinnamon.
Serve warm in wedges with whipped cream.

dishes.n: Sophie's tea tin peach iced tea

steps.text: Steep the tea bags with the sugar in boiling water.
Remove the bags, cool, then chill.
Stir in the peach nectar and lemon juice.
Fill glasses with ice and peach slices, pour over the tea and garnish with mint and lemon wheels.
